login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Club member area
login.googleOff: Google sign-in is unavailable right now.
login.googleError: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
login.emailNotConfirmed: Your email is not confirmed. Open the link in the email we sent when you signed up.

register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: One account for all your clubs
register.passwordRule: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
register.doneText: We sent an email to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm your address and log in.

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to set a new password
forgot.done: If this address is registered, an email with the link is on its way.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password to log in with
reset.passwordRule: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
reset.noToken: The link is incomplete. Request a password recovery again.
reset.done: Password changed. You can log in now.

confirm.title: Email confirmation
confirm.subtitle: Just a moment
confirm.done: Email confirmed. You can log in now.
confirm.failed: The link did not work: it has expired or was already used. Request a new email on the log in page.

home.title: Your clubs
home.loadError: Could not load your clubs. Refresh the page.
home.pendingHint: A club added you by email. Until you confirm, the club cannot see your documents and you cannot use its QR.
home.emptyTitle: You are not a member of any club yet
home.emptyText: Ask a club to send you a join link or to add you by email, and the club will show up here.

club.notMemberTitle: You are not a member of this club
club.notMemberText: The club is not in your list or the membership is not confirmed yet. Check My clubs.
club.qrHint: Show the code to staff when you come in and when you leave. It works only in this club.
club.qrClosed: The QR is unavailable until you confirm your membership.
club.reissueText: The old code stops working immediately. Do this if a screenshot of the code ended up in the wrong hands.

clubs.title: All memberships
clubs.loadError: Could not load memberships. Refresh the page.
clubs.leaveText: Your membership will be closed and the club will stop seeing your documents and signature. You can come back with a new link from the club.

confirm.title: “{club}” added you
confirm.intro: Confirm your membership and choose which documents to show the club. If nothing is selected, the club sees no documents; you can open access later.
confirm.expired: The request from “{club}” has expired. Ask the club to send it again.
confirm.noDocuments: Your account has no documents yet.
confirm.hint: You can withdraw access at any time.

passport.title: My passport
passport.subtitle: Your account documents and signature. A club sees only what you have shown it.
passport.loadError: Could not load your documents. Refresh the page.
passport.emptyText: Upload a document and decide which clubs may see it. An uploaded file is not visible to clubs by itself.
passport.deleteText: The document will disappear from your account with all its versions, and clubs it was shown to will stop seeing it.
passport.noClubs: There are no clubs yet that you could show a file to.

upload.title: New document
upload.hint: The file goes into your account. A club will see it only when you turn sharing on.
upload.fileHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 8 MB.
upload.tooBig: The file is larger than 8 MB.

signature.title: Signature
signature.tooBig: The file is larger than 2 MB.
signature.deleteText: The signature will disappear, and clubs it was shown to will stop seeing it.
